page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top, with the page number at top right. No marginal notes. Under the text: a bare reference (Thucyd.lib.3.), then the paragraph continuing into the last lines. Signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: hathematifmis profequantur multa pio-rum hominum, IESV CHRISTI no-minen inuocantium, millia. Dominus Ec-clesiæ misertus, uel conuertat eos, uel co-fundat: ac restituat Ecclesijs sinceram do-strinam & charitatem: & cum Anastasia-na & Zenonia tempora καὶ μηχανήματα [?] ἢ ὑπογραφὰς diu iam senserimus, det, ut Iu-stinianus aliquis orthodoxus exoriatur, qui ueritatis uexillũ attollentib. adsit, & CHRISTI IESV, Principis nostri summi, succenturiatũ fidelem agat: aut si minus hoc iam facere decreuit, det ut in patien-tia animas nostras possideamus. Amen.

Cogitemus etiā, [?]iorib. Ethnicis do-luisse hac tatam infirmitatem hominum, qua fit ut facile secūdis rebus inescati & languefacti, degeneres fiant, sibiq; ipsis multū difsimil s. Nota funt hæc dicta :

Ἐιωθε τῶν πόλεων αἰσ [?] ἂν μάλιστα, καὶ δὴ ἐλα-[?] χίστῃ ἀπροσδόκητος ἂν πραξία ἔλθῃ, ἐς ὕβριν τρέ-πεται. τὰ δὲ πολλὰ κατὰ λόγον τοῖς ἀνθρώποις [?] ἐν ξυνέσει, ἀσφαλείᾳ ἢ παρὰ δόξαν. καὶ ἀκανο-[?] πεαγίαν ὡς εἰπεῖν, ῥᾷον ἀπωθήσονται, ἢ ἐνδιαμονὴ [?] ἐν διαφθορᾷ. Thucyd.lib.3.
Iustinus lib.8. Thebanos, cum rerum potirentur, secundam fortunam imbecil

page.notes: Greek lines are uncertain at the line ends and in the middle of several words (marked [?]); the printed letters are partly blurred. The first word "hathematifmis" is a fragment: the initial letter is cut off at the page start. "Faniorib." is probably "seniorib." (marked [?]). The last line ends with a half word ("imbecil"), and the catchword "Ioanis" is partly cut off at the foot. Running head "HABACVC" is printed with a V for the vowel; it is written here as HABACUC according to the u/v rule. The bottom-right reads "Ioanis" but only "lo ani" is clearly visible.
